items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: Paul plays with me right regularly now.

ctx.x: That's the last job you played, huh?

That's the last job I played. And my father was there while I went and played a few numbers for my daddy, we gave him a little party. That was nice. And we circled around. I sure wish I could have touched with you, you could have, yeah. Yeah, like a serenade, huh? Yeah, a serenade. So we left him there and went down with Paul, some of his relations down next to the Union Hall. What was that, Paul, Paul who? Paul, Paul.
Paul, yeah? Yeah. Well, they don't do those things like that very much anymore.
